title: GSE causal circular exit-set process three-seed training
purpose: Determine whether normalized finite-set likelihood plus explicit cardinality learns safe continuous exit sets and full geometry before node generation.

approval.scope: One immutable Gate-3 three-seed set-process training: C01-C06 gradients, C07 checkpoint/refusal selection, C08 one zero-adaptation transfer; no C09/C10/M-TARE/graph/planner.
approval.confirmation_reference: User delegated best-method choices and continuous execution without routine approval prompts.

raw_sources: Sealed C01-C08 deduplicated causal LiDAR shards.
source.license_or_allowed_use: Local project-generated procedural worlds and objective targets.

worlds.fit: Exact S01-S10 x C01-C06: 60 worlds and only gradient source.
worlds.selection: C07 selects checkpoint and one refusal threshold; C08 is one final zero-adaptation transfer only.
worlds.forbidden: C09, C10 and all M-TARE worlds

sampling.rule: Identical deterministic world shuffle and 4-column circular rolls as V1/V2. All four count classes use ordinary fixed cross-entropy with no class or loss weights; C07/C08 receive no augmentation/update.

teacher.source: Exact circular exit centers/residual/width/profile plus objective local axis and width/height/slope/curvature masks.
teacher.use: All true exits share one normalized set mass likelihood per row; exit count 1-4 uses cross-entropy; geometry losses remain exact-center masked.
teacher.valid_mask: Residual/profile exact exits; width independent exit mask; global geometry four-value mask.
teacher.student_input: Five causal normalized range/valid frames only.
teacher.planner_consistency_plan: No graph is created; later edges remain physical-traversal-only.

split.fit: C01-C06 gradients and circular augmentation only.
split.checkpoint_and_threshold_selection: C07 minimum total set-process validation loss selects each checkpoint. Ensemble C07 selects maximum-recall observation refusal threshold at exit precision >=0.995 using fixed score=count confidence x minimum normalized selected mass.
split.strict_test: C08 applies frozen checkpoints/score/threshold once. C09/C10/M-TARE unread.
split.historical_pollution_audit: All seeds start from scratch; V1/V2 checkpoints are baseline evidence only.

methods.main: Three from-scratch 769784-parameter causal circular exit-set processes with normalized mass, explicit count, continuous residual/geometry and probability-mean ensemble.
methods.baseline: Frozen independent-peak V2 strict AP 0.110522/0.097221 with no safe threshold; raw range AP 0.051493.
methods.fallback: Any C07/C08 safety, cardinality, exact-set, geometry or system failure stops before nodes/graph; no oracle count, tolerance change, retraining or planner compensation.

acceptance.continuous_exit_set: C07-selected refusal yields one-to-one continuous bearing tolerance <=2 degrees, exit precision >=0.995 and recall >=0.50 on C07 and C08. Two degrees is half the minimum collision-free 4-degree center separation and is not selected from model errors.
acceptance.cardinality: Raw 1-4 count accuracy >=0.80 and deployed terminal/corridor/junction macro-F1 >=0.80 on both; exact correct set fraction across all observations >=0.50.
acceptance.peak_geometry: Matched bearing MAE <=1 degree, width MAE <=3 m and vertical profile MAE <=1 m.
acceptance.global_geometry: Axis <=10 degrees; width/height <=2 m; slope <=2 degrees; curvature <=0.02 per m.
acceptance.selection: C08 checkpoint observations/updates zero; one C07 refusal threshold; all three seeds reported.

failure_policy: Any system drift stops. Scientific failure seals FAIL and stops before node generation; no retry, oracle cardinality, wider matching, class weighting, threshold relaxation, seed selection or planner compensation.
retention: Retain three checkpoints/histories/summaries, compact predictions, continuous set/refusal/cardinality/geometry metrics, per-world table, figures/source, environment, logs, RUN_STATE and seal.

estimated_cost.compute: Three sequential CUDA trainings plus C07/C08 evaluation
